title: GTA IV: Alternate Timelines
subtitle: The old country follows you to the new one, usually armed.

achievements.title: City Made
achievements.description: Build your own syndicate in Liberty.

achievements.title: Cousin Keeper
achievements.description: Keep family alive through the final conflict.

achievements.title: Old World Ghost
achievements.description: Erase your past with federal help.

achievements.title: American Dream
achievements.description: Leave crime and build a legal life.

boat_in.title: Boat In
text: You arrive in Liberty expecting bright lights, easy money, and maybe one honest taxi. You get gray skies, debt collectors, and a cousin with entrepreneurial delusions.
He says this is the land of opportunity. By opportunity, he means owing money to men who pronounce your name like a threat.
The old country war is behind you, but its phone calls are not.

choices.label: Help your cousin stabilize his business
Go after the debt collectors directly

broker_hustle.title: Broker Hustle
text: You spend nights driving fares, days dodging gang enforcers, and afternoons pretending the check-engine light is optional.
Your cousin flirts with danger and women in equal amounts, with approximately the same success rate.
A local loan shark offers a truce if you run one dirty favor that is definitely not one dirty favor.

choices.label: Run the favor and buy time
Reject and build your own leverage

collector_night.title: Collector Night
text: You hunt debt collectors through rain-soaked projects and find out quickly that all of them are employees, not owners.
The boss behind them has old-country contacts and new-world lawyers. A dangerous combination.
He offers a deal: do jobs for him and your family debt shrinks. Refuse and your family tree loses branches.

choices.label: Take contracts and infiltrate his network
Retaliate publicly and force a reputation war

dock_job.title: Dock Job
text: At the docks, container cranes move slower than betrayal but with similar precision.
You intercept contraband linked to war profiteers from your homeland. Faces from your past reappear with expensive coats and cheap morality.
Now the question is simple: profit with monsters, or betray them before they betray you.

choices.label: Profit first and stay inside their machine
Burn old contacts and protect your family

nightclub_meet.title: Nightclub Meet
text: A nightclub owner with political donors and paramilitary bodyguards invites you upstairs for champagne and coercion.
He needs someone reliable to mediate between Balkan crews, street gangs, and white-collar thieves in suits worth more than your first apartment.
You can become his trusted operator, his replacement, or his biggest mistake.

choices.label: Become his operator and scale quietly
Undermine him and prepare a takeover

agency_offer.title: Agency Offer
text: Federal agents corner you with files, photos, and the kind of smile that says they already know the answer.
They offer witness protection, debt forgiveness, and one very fake new identity if you feed them names.
Your cousin says never trust them. Your survival instinct says trust is not the point.

choices.label: Feed the feds selectively and play both sides
Refuse and settle it your own way

final_reckoning.title: Final Reckoning
text: Everything converges at once: old-country killers, new-world investors, and politicians who insist they have never met you while calling your burner phone.
Your family needs protection, your crew needs direction, and your enemies need graves or paychecks.
Liberty offers no happy endings, only expensive compromises.

choices.label: Take over operations and build your own syndicate
Cash out and start legal life

ending_city_made.title: City Made
text: You outlast everyone and turn Liberty's underworld into a disciplined business empire.
The city still hates you, but now it does so on your schedule.

ending.title: City Made
ending.summary: You become a top-tier power broker in Liberty City.

ending_cousin_keeper.title: Cousin Keeper
text: You abandon maximum profit to get your people out alive.
Your cousin still talks too much, still drives too fast, and still calls you a hero at least twice a day.

ending.title: Cousin Keeper
ending.summary: You protect family and survive, even if the empire stays smaller.

ending_old_world_ghost.title: Old World Ghost
text: You disappear into witness relocation where your new job is pretending your past was a long administrative misunderstanding.
No one can find you. Not your enemies, not your friends, not even your own reflection some mornings.

ending.title: Old World Ghost
ending.summary: You erase your criminal identity in exchange for survival.

ending_american_dream.title: American Dream
text: You buy a legal business, pay taxes through clenched teeth, and discover that paperwork can be scarier than gunfire.
It is not glamorous, but it is yours.

ending.title: American Dream
ending.summary: You leave organized crime and build a legitimate life.
